references.title: Google Street View actual Norssi entrance/recessed upper northwest wall, August2024; nine upper round arches in three groups and smaller lower arches opened
Helsinki City Museum primary record of the separate historic Normaalilyseo school buildings

observations: The same actual August2024 public view shows a forward low porch with three large round-arched glazed windows on each side and a broad red-brick entrance arch in the middle.
A central timber door with rectangular panels and two narrower arched side lights sit above visible shallow entrance steps. Original geometry, porch projections and stair support remain unchanged.

Original roof-relative colour/line architecture represents the observed porch. Door/window sizes and the top-relative entrance datum are approximate appearance placements, not surveyed ground or a new collision claim.
limitations: Only six exact front-facing source facets on the three porch support planes are selected. Narrow side returns, stair geometry, street wings and the other historic school block remain unqualified.
The separate recessed-upper profile is required for the wall behind this porch. This profile must not be claimed as coverage of the whole school BID.
No reference pixels, people, cars, text or reflected trees are reproduced. Actual runtime and final fresh-world review required.
